sources.source_name: Wikimedia Commons license review for external uploads
sources.purpose: Check external-source license review limits and author ownership checks before reusing Wikimedia-hosted YouTube videos
sources.cost_quota: free public documentation, no API key
sources.reliability_limits: License review checks the source license and author correspondence, not every third-party music or embedded footage right; each actual file needs its own review.

sources.source_name: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International legal code
sources.purpose: Verify the CC BY 4.0 license only grants rights the licensor has authority to license, and excludes third-party privacy/publicity/trademark rights
sources.cost_quota: free public legal text, no API key
sources.reliability_limits: CC legal code explains the license scope but does not establish rights ownership of any particular video or music track.

learning.title: Commons-reviewed YouTube footage still needs component-rights clearance
learning.claim: Wikimedia Commons license review verifies an external site's stated free license at review time, but does not independently establish that every embedded video, music track or third-party element is cleared; CC BY 4.0 licenses only rights the licensor has authority to grant.
learning.decision: SHORTS_THIRD_PARTY_COMPONENT_RIGHTS_GATE: for YouTube-sourced Commons videos, especially compilations, separately verify original uploader/author, music, embedded third-party clips, and any privacy/publicity rights relevant to intended commercial use. Record file URL, original source, license and attribution in the packet; if a component is unverified, reject the clip or use separately cleared original footage. Do not treat Commons license review alone as monetization clearance.
learning.next_measurement: For the next food/entertainment Shorts candidate, test a compilation with missing component rights (must fail) and an individually filmed CC BY clip with documented rights/attribution (can proceed to separate originality/QC gate). Record source IDs and applied_learning_ids only if a real decision uses this gate.
fallback_history: If ownership or embedded audio rights are unclear, prefer self-shot or independently licensed footage; do not infer permission from uploader claims.
